description: Propose changes to a page as SUGGESTIONS (tracked changes) that someone who can edit the page accepts or rejects in the page; nothing changes until they do. Each edit is { find, replace }: `find` is text copied exactly from the page, occurring once, inside one paragraph, heading, list item or table cell; `replace` is the new text (empty to remove). Only pages edited live can carry suggestions. The result says which edits were applied and which did not match.
name: anyforge_propose_page_edit
title: Propose page edit
